answers.M6-S1: When you really want something, like being tall, you can believe things that aren't true and get tricked.
answers.M6-S2: Because Peg Bowen the witch might find out he gave her seed away and get mad at him.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being kind and the seed is real, but the reader can tell Billy is probably tricking him to get ten cents.
answers.M6-S4: Because Uncle Alec said he was going to be short, and he was worried and wanted to grow taller fast.
answers.M6-S5: Because taking the seed was an awful experience for him, so he doesn't want any more of it, and that makes it sound strong and real.
answers.M6-S6: It shows he still hasn't grown, but he keeps hoping, which makes it kind of funny because the seed probably doesn't work.
answers.M6-S7: To show why the narrator believes him, because Billy being so tall makes it seem like the magic seed really works.
answers.M6-S8: That Billy wasn't really liked that much by people, maybe because he wasn't very nice or honest.
answers.M6-S9: He likes his uncle a lot but he doesn't want to be short like him. He wants to grow taller.
